product_summary: Dekton Aura 15 is a premium sintered stone countertop that offers exceptional heat and scratch resistance through high-temperature manufacturing. While it excels in daily durability against common kitchen hazards, independent testing reveals it's prone to catastrophic cracking from impact damage that other materials survive.

beats_expectations: 25-year transferable warranty is longer than most countertop materials
Covers UV damage for outdoor applications unlike quartz warranties
underperforms_expectations: Excludes impact damage and edge chipping—the exact failure modes most commonly reported
Warranty doesn't cover the material's primary documented weakness
surprises: Must register within 6 months or warranty drops from 25 years to just 3 years
Registration deadline not prominently disclosed at purchase

buyer_considerations.text: Consumer Reports testing showed Dekton was the only material to crack completely when simulating dropped cookware—a common kitchen accident
Must register warranty within 6 months or coverage drops from 25 years to 3 years—deadline rarely disclosed upfront
Requires specialized fabrication knowledge for proper edge finishing—inexperienced shops increase chipping risk

serviceability_summary: Strong global service network through Cosentino Centers, but impact damage repairs are complex and warranty excludes the most common failure modes
material_health_summary: Greenguard Gold certified with NSF food-contact approval for end users. Crystalline silica content creates occupational hazard during fabrication but poses no risk once installed.
